evals.prompt: Use the ai-chat-agents skill. I have a Next.js route handler that calls streamText for a chat UI. Move it to a durable Trigger.dev chat agent. Our self-hosted server is on version 4.4.4. Write the migrated code in full, then say what else I have to do.
evals.expected_output: Should define chat.agent with the streamText taken from the run argument, the two server actions, useTriggerChatTransport, and warn that chat agents and sessions need server 4.5.0 or newer
expectations: The answer defines the agent with chat.agent from @trigger.dev/sdk/ai
The answer takes streamText from the run argument instead of importing it from ai
The answer passes signal as abortSignal
The answer says chat agents and sessions need server 4.5.0 or newer
